end.summary:
- Practised levels of organisation in humans and plants.
- Gave examples including heart, liver, digestive system, leaf, and root system.
- Ordered cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism in later turns.
- Explained that an organ system has several organs and parts, not just one organ.
- Teach-back was not passed; ordering was unaided correct in 2 of 4 attempts.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the sequence from cell to organism and used team-based examples to connect the levels. Yash explained that cells form tissues, tissues form organs, and organs work together in organ systems; they also corrected the mix-up that the heart alone is not the whole circulatory system. At home, ask them to make one human and one plant example for each level and say the sequence aloud.
